code.text: COAG
PANEL.MICRO

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia, anemia (low hemoglobin, MCHC), mild thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, elevated ferritin, LDH, CRP, INR, and mild renal impairment (high urea, creatinine). There is also mild hypoglycemia and low total protein. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible bone marrow suppression, and impaired oxygenation, but no evidence of acute myocardial injury or COVID-19 infection. Urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
